about: [O3] look development: the city's crowd, the camera turned onto the nearest walkers (not a proof)

steps.eval: (() => { const P = G.people, E = G.eye; const L = P.list.filter(p => p.role === 'walker').sort((a, b) => a.pos.distanceTo(E) - b.pos.distanceTo(E)); const p = L[0]; const C = G.controller; const dx = p.pos.x - C.pos.x, dz = p.pos.z - C.pos.z, d = Math.hypot(dx, dz); C.setPose(p.pos.x - dx / d * 9, p.pos.z - dz / d * 9, Math.atan2(dx, dz) + Math.PI, -0.04); return [p.kind, +d.toFixed(1)]; })()
